title: Straight-line dense arithmetic with finite sorted-checkpoint inversion

claims.statement: The complete analytic algorithm in proof.md solves the production supplied-P pairing inversion problem with success at least 0.39 under its sole disclosed SHA-256 idealization, total cold work below 2^(3231/25) dense Fp12 equivalents at fixed C=20000, peak storage below 2^35 bytes, and zero nonuniform advice. All setup, failures, arithmetic, lookup, insertion, hashing, transfers, verification and G2 output are charged. This is an exploratory heuristic bound, not practical execution.
